# Three.js runtime

`three.module.js` and `three.core.js` are unmodified Three.js **0.180.0** builds, downloaded from the npm package via jsDelivr. The adjacent `THREE-LICENSE.txt` contains its MIT license.

The game serves this pinned runtime locally and does not rely on a third-party CDN at play time.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/releases/tag/r180
